test_cases.description: CLI includes git_pat field in POST /workspaces JSON body when --git-pat flag is provided.
preconditions: afc CLI binary is built and available
A mock HTTP server is listening to capture the outgoing POST /workspaces request
A valid HTTPS git_url is provided

input.command: afc workspace create --slug my-ws --git-url https://github.com/acme/private --git-pat ghp_abc123

test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: capturedBody = interceptHTTPRequest(POST, '/workspaces'); assert capturedBody['git_pat'] == 'ghp_abc123'; assert 'ghp_abc123' not in stdout; assert 'ghp_abc123' not in stderr

test_cases.description: CLI includes git_username and git_password fields in POST /workspaces JSON body when --git-username and --git-password flags are provided.
preconditions: afc CLI binary is built and available
A mock HTTP server is listening to capture the outgoing POST /workspaces request
A valid HTTPS git_url is provided

input.command: afc workspace create --slug my-ws --git-url https://github.com/acme/private --git-username alice --git-password s3cr3t

test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: capturedBody = interceptHTTPRequest(POST, '/workspaces'); assert capturedBody['git_username'] == 'alice'; assert capturedBody['git_password'] == 's3cr3t'; assert 'alice' not in stdout; assert 's3cr3t' not in stderr

test_cases.description: CLI rejects the command with a mutual-exclusion error and non-zero exit code when both --git-pat and --git-username/--git-password are provided.
preconditions: afc CLI binary is built and available
No HTTP server is needed (request must not be sent)

input.command: afc workspace create --slug my-ws --git-url https://github.com/acme/private --git-pat ghp_abc --git-username alice --git-password s3cr3t

test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: result = runCLI('afc workspace create --slug my-ws --git-url https://github.com/acme/private --git-pat ghp_abc --git-username alice --git-password s3cr3t'); assert result.exitCode != 0; assert 'mutually exclusive' in result.stderr (case-insensitive); assert noHTTPRequestWasSent()

test_cases.description: CLI rejects the command with a pair-completeness error and non-zero exit code when only --git-username is provided without --git-password.

input.command: afc workspace create --slug my-ws --git-url https://github.com/acme/private --git-username alice

test_cases.description: CLI rejects the command with an HTTPS-requirement error and non-zero exit code when credential flags are provided with a non-HTTPS git_url.
preconditions: afc CLI binary is built and available
No HTTP server is needed (request must not be sent)

test_cases.description: CLI delegates error rendering to apikit.CLIHandleError when the API returns HTTP 400, printing the formatted error to stderr and exiting non-zero.
preconditions: afc CLI binary is built and available
A mock HTTP server returns HTTP 400 with JSON body {"error": "credential validation failed for https://github.com/acme/private: unable to authenticate"}

property_tests.description: For any POST /workspaces request containing both git_pat and at least one of git_username or git_password, the handler always returns HTTP 400 and never inserts a workspace row or calls CreateSecrets.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random combinations of non-empty git_pat with non-empty git_username and/or git_password, paired with random valid HTTPS git_url and slug values. Use at least 50 samples covering: (pat+username), (pat+password), (pat+username+password).
property_tests.invariant_check: for each generated request: resp.status == 400 AND workspaceNotInDB(slug) AND createSecretsCallCount == 0

property_tests.description: For any POST /workspaces request containing any credential field, ValidateCredentialsFuncType is always invoked before any database INSERT, and if it returns a non-nil error, no workspace row is inserted and no secrets are stored.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random valid requests with git_pat or (git_username + git_password), with ValidateCredentialsFuncType stubbed to return either nil or a random error. Use at least 100 samples with 50% error rate.
property_tests.invariant_check: if validateCredentialsFn returned non-nil error: workspaceNotInDB(slug) AND secretsCount == 0; if returned nil: validateCredentialsFn was called before any DB INSERT (verified via call ordering spy)

property_tests.description: For any scenario where workspace INSERT succeeds but CreateSecrets returns an error and the compensating DELETE succeeds, no workspace row with the given slug exists in the database afterward.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random valid workspace slugs and PAT values. Stub ValidateCredentialsFuncType to return nil, stub CreateSecrets to return a random error, and allow the compensating DELETE to succeed. Use at least 50 samples.
property_tests.invariant_check: after handler returns: workspaceNotInDB(slug) == true for all samples where compensating DELETE succeeded

property_tests.description: For any HTTP response from POST /workspaces, the response body never contains the plaintext value of git_pat, git_username, or git_password.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random credential values (random alphanumeric strings of length 8-64) for git_pat, git_username, and git_password. Send requests with various outcomes (success, validation failure, auth failure, DB failure). Use at least 100 samples.
property_tests.invariant_check: for each response: credentialValue not in serialize(resp.body) for all three credential fields

property_tests.description: For any workspace with GIT_PAT stored in the secrets table, CloneFuncType is always called with BasicAuth{Username: 'x-token-auth', Password: <pat>} and never with nil auth.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random PAT values (random alphanumeric strings of length 8-64) stored as GIT_PAT secrets for random workspace slugs. Process clone jobs for each workspace. Use at least 50 samples.
property_tests.invariant_check: for each clone invocation: cloneFn.args.auth != nil AND cloneFn.args.auth.Username == 'x-token-auth' AND cloneFn.args.auth.Password == storedPAT

property_tests.description: For any workspace with no GIT_PAT, GIT_USERNAME, or GIT_PASSWORD secrets, CloneFuncType is always called with auth=nil.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random workspace slugs with no credential secrets stored. Process clone jobs for each workspace. Use at least 50 samples.
property_tests.invariant_check: for each clone invocation: cloneFn.args.auth == nil

property_tests.description: For any invocation of the production ValidateCredentialsFuncType, the context passed to Remote.ListContext always has a deadline no greater than 10 seconds from the time of invocation.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Instrument the production ValidateCredentialsFuncType to capture the context deadline before calling Remote.ListContext. Invoke it with random git URLs and BasicAuth values. Use at least 20 samples.
property_tests.invariant_check: for each invocation: context.Deadline() - invocationTime <= 10*time.Second AND context.Deadline() is set (not zero)

property_tests.description: For any call to GetSecretValue where the key exists and the stored value is valid base64, the returned string is always the base64-decoded plaintext value.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random plaintext strings (length 1-256, any printable ASCII). Base64-encode them, insert into the secrets table, then call GetSecretValue. Use at least 100 samples.
property_tests.invariant_check: for each sample: val, err = store.GetSecretValue(...); assert err == nil; assert val == originalPlaintext; assert val != base64EncodedValue

property_tests.description: For any credential-bearing request where git_url does not start with 'https://', both the CLI and the API handler independently reject the request before any network or database operation.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random non-HTTPS URLs (http://, git@, ssh://, file://, ftp://) paired with random credential values (git_pat or git_username+git_password). Test both CLI and API handler. Use at least 50 samples per layer.
property_tests.invariant_check: CLI: exitCode != 0 AND noHTTPRequestSent; API: resp.status == 400 AND workspaceNotInDB(slug) AND validateCredentialsFnCallCount == 0

property_tests.description: For any workspace deletion via deleteWorkspace() where the workspace has associated credential secrets, after successful deletion no secrets with owner_type='workspace' and owner_id=slug remain in the secrets table.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random workspace slugs with random combinations of GIT_PAT, GIT_USERNAME, and GIT_PASSWORD secrets (all present, some present, none present). Call deleteWorkspace for each. Use at least 50 samples.
property_tests.invariant_check: for each successful deletion: countSecretsInDB('workspace', slug) == 0

smoke_tests.description: End-to-end happy path: create workspace with PAT for private repo, validate credentials, store secret, enqueue clone, and clone with auth.
smoke_tests.trigger: Developer runs `afc workspace create --slug my-ws --git-url https://github.com/acme/private --git-pat ghp_abc123`
mockable: ValidateCredentialsFuncType (stub returning nil instead of real Remote.ListContext)
CloneFuncType (stub returning a fake headSHA instead of real PlainCloneContext)
expected_effects: POST /workspaces returns HTTP 201 with workspace JSON body containing slug='my-ws'
Workspace row exists in SQLite with slug='my-ws'
Secret GIT_PAT exists in secrets table with owner_type='workspace', owner_id='my-ws', base64-encoded value
Clone job is enqueued for workspace 'my-ws'
Clone worker calls CloneFuncType with BasicAuth{Username: 'x-token-auth', Password: 'ghp_abc123'}
Workspace clone_status is updated to 'succeeded' after clone completes
No credential values appear in any log entry

smoke_tests.description: Failure path: invalid PAT is rejected at creation time with HTTP 400 and sanitised error message; no workspace row is created.
smoke_tests.trigger: Developer runs `afc workspace create --slug my-ws --git-url https://github.com/acme/private --git-pat wrong-token`
mockable: ValidateCredentialsFuncType (stub returning authentication error instead of real Remote.ListContext)
expected_effects: POST /workspaces returns HTTP 400 with JSON body {"error": "credential validation failed for https://github.com/acme/private: unable to authenticate"}
No workspace row exists in SQLite for slug='my-ws'
No secrets are written to the secrets table
No clone job is enqueued
Raw go-git error is logged at ERROR level server-side
CLI exits with non-zero exit code
CLI stderr contains the formatted error message from apikit.CLIHandleError

expected_effects: POST /workspaces returns HTTP 500 with a JSON error body
